title: JBL's New Party Speaker Has an AI Karaoke Feature You May Actually Want to Use
key_facts: JBL announced the PartyBox Ultimate 2 party speaker, priced at $1,800.
It has 1,500 watts of output, six drivers and weighs 120 pounds, with no battery.
Its AI isolation feature removes vocals from any track at the push of a button, which Gizmodo says suits karaoke.
Other AI features are AI Sound Boost and Smart EQ Mode.
It supports AirPlay 2, Spotify Connect and Chromecast, and wired inputs including USB-C, optical and XLR.
Preorders are open and shipping starts 25 Oct 2026.
The writer has not tested this model, only the vocal feature on a different JBL product.
quote_evidence: The $1,800 JBL PartyBox Ultimate 2 is an absolute unit.
JBL put its AI isolation features in the PartyBox Ultimate 2, which means you can strip out vocals from tracks you're playing with the push of a button.
I've not used this feature on the PartyBox 2, obviously (it just came out)
why_it_matters_hint: AI vocal removal is arriving in consumer party gear.
notes: Gizmodo has not tested the speaker.
